stage1.impression: A tight detail of a floating black basin against vertical oiled timber boards with a wall spout and a mixer button; the boards carry believable grain, knots and nail holes, and the spout has a decent brushed sheen. But the basin reads as a crushed black stone or lacquered box, not cast acrylic: its front face is a dead void with no edge, no thickness and no glow, the bowl is a black hole, and a pale smeared vertical strip on the left (a stretched texture or an out-of-focus light leak) says render. As it stands a magazine would not run it as a specific place; it is a generic dark-wood washroom.

blocking_9: The slab must read as thick smoked cast acrylic glowing warm amber through its thickness: front face [150,340,625,475] lum_median >= 35 with a visible gradient, not crushed (crush_pct < 20).
Polished edges of the slab must catch light: a bright line along the top front arris and the left vertical edge.
The bowl [235,270,510,330] must show its soft rounded form (lum_p95 >= 45, crush_pct < 40), lit from within.
The pale smeared vertical strip at [40,0,60,480] must be removed or resolved into a real object.
The linen towel on the brass rod named on the card must be in frame as the sign of life and second material.
Spout escutcheon must sit on a board face, not be clipped by a board gap.

defects.what: Front face of the slab is crushed black (lum_median 0.2, crush_pct 91, 18.5% of the frame): no acrylic, no thickness, no glow; fails the 'no region > 1/10 frame more than half crushed' rule.
Basin bowl is a black void (lum_median 0.4, crush 74); only a thin rim highlight on the right.
Pale, streaky vertical band (lum_median 131 vs 63 beside it) with stretched, smeared grain: reads as a UV-stretched texture or an unexplained light leak.
Slab's left edge is soft and dark (step 17, 18 px wide): no polished edge glint, the slab silhouette barely separates from the wall.
Spout escutcheon's right edge appears cut by the board gap line in front of it (intersection with the boarding).
Mixer button rod rises to the top of the frame as a thin dark line, reads as a floating stem.
No towel, brass rod or other prop despite the card; frame reads empty and generic.
Slab top shows mirror reflections of the boards but no translucency or smoked tint: reads as gloss black paint.
